title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-jul-2026-draft
body:
Goal:
- Align product + eng + applied-ml on priorities for H2 Q3 roadmap cut (focus: latency-cost improvements and model onboarding cadence).
- Surface blockers that would change scope (infra capacity, dataset labeling backlog, quantization experiments).

Attendees (ask to confirm):
- Priya (PM, hosted-api) — will present top-level tradeoffs and customer asks
- Ben (Eng lead, serving-runtime) — capacity and rollout constraints
- Noah (Applied ML) — model quality/regression risk + eval plan
- Maria (Product Ops) — rollout calendar + stakeholder comms
- Me (Aisha) — synthesize and take action items

Pre-reads (send 24h before):
- Current proposed roadmap deck (confluence link above) — page 2-6 for features list
- Benchmark table: latency/cost by model variant (internal sheet)
- Open PRs list affecting runtime scheduling (github link above)

Agenda (30-40m sync):
1) 0-5m quick context / success metrics we care about (SLOs: p95 token latency < 300ms for small models; target cost reduction 20% by end of Q3)
2) 5-15m Product presents priority list + rationale (customer signals + revenue impact)
3) 15-30m Eng + Applied ML: feasibility and risks per item (rough ETA and required resources)
   - batching + dynamic routing changes (impact on latency SLO + rollout risk)
   - KV cache prefetcher experiment (applied-ml to share eval plan)
   - model quantization profile adoption (dependencies: CI, safety evals)
4) 30-35m Dependencies + blockers (infra capacity, labeling, telemetry gaps)
5) 35-40m Actions, owners, dates.

Key discussion points to prep (notes to self):
- Product: be ready to defend revenue impact numbers (# customers impacted, ARR uplift). If they are fuzzy, ask for committed customers/POCs.
- Eng: prepare quick table of rollout timeline for each change (canary/beta windows, expected perf delta).
- Applied ML: bring a short A/B eval plan and thresholds for quality regression (metrics + test prompts).
- Ops: confirm sprint capacity for July and any hard constraints on Dedicated infra.

Risks I want flagged during sync:
- Any change that increases p95 tail due to batching (we need quant numbers)
- Model quality regressions from more aggressive quantization (Noah to triage)
- Hidden migration cost for private deployments (customer upgrade pain)

Open questions (to voice in meeting):
- Is there appetite for moving 2 mid-priority items to next quarter to free up eng cycles for quantization work?
- What is the minimal test set Noah needs to sign off on quantization? Timeline?
- Where do we want to draw the line on automated fallback policies (cost vs. quality tradeoff)?

Proposed action items (draft — will convert to tasks in Jira during/after sync):
- ACTION: Ben — provide per-change ETA + canary rollout plan by 2026-07-06 (JIRA-RED-2145 subtask)
- ACTION: Noah — publish quantization eval plan + baseline on 2026-07-05 (include prompt set + evaluation thresholds)
- ACTION: Maria — update stakeholder comms calendar and draft customer-facing note for Dedicated customers by 2026-07-08
- ACTION: Aisha (me) — consolidate notes and create follow-up RFC doc by 2026-07-09, assign owners
- ACTION: Priya — confirm top 3 customer commitments and ARR justification before sync (ideally via Slack thread)

Notes / scratch thoughts (freeform):
- Might need to propose a small experimental squad (2 eng + 1 applied-ml) focused on quantization + deployability — probably 6-week focused effort.
- Consider running a short customer beta for new routing policy (10 customers) to validate end-to-end metrics. Need list from CS.
- Telemetry gaps: we still don't have token-level cost breakdown for private deployments — blocking for cost estimates. Add to ops backlog.

Post-meeting follow-up (template):
- Send summary + owners within 24 hours, link to RFC, create Jira epic and assign sub-tasks, schedule deep-dive if needed.

TODOs before meeting (today / next 48h):
- Ping Priya for revenue numbers (Aisha)
- Ping Ben for rough ETA table (Ben)
- Draft eval checklist and share with Noah (Aisha)
